findings.title: Room refresh failures are dropped with no log and no signal to peers.
findings.body:
Before this change, a failed refresh returned `cannot refresh repo collaboration` and the connection closed. Now `refreshOnce` returns without a trace when `FetchChanges` fails. When `Apply` fails, it only resets `r.position`.

Two things go wrong when the failure keeps happening (for example, heads that cannot be decoded, a snapshot that will not load, or a merge that always fails):
- Peers keep editing a stale document with nothing logged and no error sent to them.
- With the position reset to zero, `FetchChanges` never returns nil. Every 500 ms poll then reloads the full snapshot and change log and merges it while holding `docMu`. That is the same lock-holding work this PR set out to remove.

Nothing in the room records the error. I could not check whether `FetchChanges` logs internally; in the code shown it does not.

**Fix:** log both errors with the document ID (give the room a logger). Consider backing off, or showing the failure to connections, after repeated failures.
